rationale: The agent did not complete the user’s exchange request in line with policy. While there are read-only tool calls (finding user by email and fetching user and order details), there is no evidence of full authentication, identification of the correct order/item, confirmation from the user before performing any order-changing action, or execution of the exchange (no RMA/label or exchange order creation). There is also no final confirmation or clear outcome presented. The session ends with a farewell, indicating no action was taken. Therefore, it fails the pass bar.
